text: Ibuliisa alanaa ɓe cemmbe, ɗe o wurtirta ɓe e majjere. Ko o woni cuɗirande ɓe o hoomtaɓe e majjere ndee, ko ko Men duŋorani mo, fii no Men senndindira hakkunde on gomɗinɗo laakara e njoɓdi mun e on wonɗo e sikke fii laakara. Joomi maa non, an Nulaaɗo, e dow kala huunde, ko O reenuɗo: Himo mofti golle jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, O yoɓitoyay ɓe e ɗum.
